# Yantai Dingdingmiao Seafood

> Seafood trading and sourcing company in Yantai, China, serving global buyers across seafood categories.

We welcome any seafood inquiry, including products outside the catalog. We help importers, distributors and processors investigate supply options, coordinate quotations and support agreed transactions. Services and commission or fee arrangements are agreed per engagement. Availability, origin, certificates, prices and shipping terms are confirmed per order.
